_doc: Dismissals for Skill Radar. When the owner skips a proposed new skill (in morning-ops or by hand), append its key here so detect.py stops re-surfacing it. Format: { "<sr-key>": { "label": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": "..." } }. ALWAYS include the date: a dated dismissal expires after DISMISS_EXPIRY_DAYS (~120d, set in detect.py) so a once-rejected idea can re-surface if it later becomes relevant. An undated entry is treated as a permanent never-again.
